conditions.text: units first receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent increase limits (r-0027)

rules.support: r-0027 coverage text: units first receiving a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the Rent Ordinance's rent increase limits; r-0026 applies to rent-controlled units.
rules.reasoning: r-0026 covers rent-controlled units, and r-0027 says post-June 13, 1979 units are exempt from the rent increase limits, so coverage is units first occupied on or before that date.
rules.plain_en: For rent-controlled units, the most a landlord can raise rent from March 2026 to February 2027 is 1.6% of base rent.

result.notes: The Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancy and government-regulated rent exemptions in r-0027 were not added as conditions because they cannot be tested from parcel data and are not stated as exemptions to r-0026 itself.
